description:
Extracted adverse-event rates for a named drug or trial, by arm, with the arithmetic that was checked.

`verification` is carried through verbatim. It is the raw-count recomputation recorded when the
row was extracted ("997/2481 active = 40.18%"), and it is what lets a caller see that the
percentage was checked against the paper rather than copied from an abstract.
name: get_adverse_events
title: Get adverse event rates
